subject: Observability renewals: pricing bids and retention addon triage
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Neal <liam.oneal@datadog.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@grafana.com>, Carlos Mendez <c.mendez@sentry.io>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, ProcureOps <procure@acmecorp.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Aug 2025 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Observability renewals: pricing bids and retention addon triage

Hi all,

We have a concentrated window to finalize renewals for Datadog, Grafana Cloud, and Sentry retention add-ons. Nimbus Health (our production account) is rolling a retention policy change that will increase ingest and footprint through Q4; procurement asked for bundled pricing/options to hit budget targets.

Ask: please send updated quotes that include the following by EOD Thursday (14 AUG) —
- 12-month and 24-month pricing (ingest + retention add-ons)
- Any committed-use or reserve discounts, burst capacity terms, and egress considerations
- Explicit line-item for prefix/KV cache telemetry if you offer caching credits or tiered billing

Attachments: I pulled the last baseline quotes for context (Procurement_RFI_responses.zip).

Internal note: Naomi, Ben — can you confirm target spend envelope and must-have SLOs? Olga — if you have any constraints for private-pipeline routing that would change vendor suitability, flag them now.

Thanks,
Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Infrastructure Finance (acting)
Redwood Inference
From: Liam O'Neal <liam.oneal@datadog.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, ProcureOps <procure@acmecorp.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Aug 2025 15:02:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Observability renewals: pricing bids and retention addon triage

Karthik —

Thanks for the heads up. I've attached an updated pricing summary (Datadog_Pricing_2025.pdf) with three scenarios: baseline (no commit), reserved annual, and 2-year commit with burst capacity. Key points:
- 2-year commit saves ~28% on token ingestion and retention add-ons vs baseline.
- We can provide a 30% discount on the retention add-on for the first 6 months to help smoothing.
- Egress: standard cross-region egress applies; we can propose a dedicated export pipeline to reduce per-GB egress costs, which would be a separate engineering effort.

On caching: Datadog's prefix/KV cache is not billed as a line item today but we can add credits (time-limited) for customers migrating to a cached flow. We included a worked example for Nimbus Health in the PDF.

If you want, we can schedule a 30-minute run-through with engineering to validate export paths and SLO alignment.

—Liam
Liam O'Neal
Enterprise Sales, Datadog
liam.oneal@datadog.com
From: ProcureOps <procure@acmecorp.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 13 Aug 2025 09:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Observability renewals: pricing bids and retention addon triage

Karthik / Naomi —

Quick procurement checklist based on the vendors' replies:
- Need consolidated SOW + redlines for any vendors offering burst capacity or export pipelines.
- Legal wants the retention addon SLAs and data deletion controls (esp. for healthcare PHI) clearly documented.
- Please confirm whether the team prefers a single-vendor bundled commit or multiple smaller commits (we see savings in a larger single vendor commit but risk of vendor lock-in).

Attachments received: Datadog_Pricing_2025.pdf (from Liam). Still pending updated sheets from Grafana + Sentry.

Procurement will prepare a net-present-value comparison if you confirm the candidate list by EOD.

Regards,
ProcureOps
Acme Procurement Services
From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@grafana.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, ProcureOps <procure@acmecorp.com>
Date: Wed, 13 Aug 2025 11:27:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Observability renewals: pricing bids and retention addon triage

Hi Karthik + team —

Apologies for the quick turnaround; attached is our exportable quote (GrafanaCloud_quote_Q3.xlsx). Highlights:
- Grafana Cloud bundling (metrics + logs + traces) with a flat retention add-on cap; 12mo vs 24mo savings ~22%.
- We can include a one-off migration credit to cover S3 export connector tuning (small engineering runbook).
- Egress: if you route exports to an S3 bucket in the same region we can offer a reduced egress rate as part of the 24-month commit.

Ben / Olga — re: private pipeline — Grafana's export connector supports staged replay; we flagged implementation notes in the spreadsheet. Happy to set up a technical session.

Best,
Priya Shah
Strategic Accounts, Grafana Labs
priya.shah@grafana.com
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 14 Aug 2025 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Observability renewals: pricing bids and retention addon triage

Team —

Thanks for the vendor responses. Quick synthesis and next steps:

Synthesis:
- Datadog gives the deepest short-term discounts on retention add-ons, and they can offer limited caching credits. Egress remains the wildcard.
- Grafana's bundling looks attractive for logs+metrics+traces with a smoother egress path if we co-locate exports; their migration credit lowers our one-time lift risk.
- Sentry (no formal pricing file yet from Carlos) is likely to be competitive on error-trace retention, but we need their SLA around deletion/PII controls before we can include them in a single-contract approach.

Decision criteria (prioritized):
1) Security & data deletion controls (must have documented procedures)
2) Net cost over 24 months including egress and migration uplift (procurement to produce NPV)
3) Operational impact (engineering hours to configure export pipelines)

Action items:
- Naomi: please confirm target NPV envelope for Nimbus Health by Friday COB.
- Ben: coordinate a 45-min technical deep dive with Grafana (Priya) and Datadog (Liam) next week; invite Olga to validate export/connectivity notes.
- Olga: compile a short (1-pager) constraints doc for private-pipeline routing and KMS/HSM requirements.
- Procurement: prepare NPV comparison and draft SOW templates for 24-month bundled and multi-vendor fallback.

I'll keep the vendors looped in but for now please avoid sharing internal spend targets beyond the procurement contact. We'll reconvene after the technical deep dives.

Thanks,
Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Infrastructure Finance (acting)
Redwood Inference
